list: The official 55 trophies, as PlayStation publishes them (names, descriptions and grades verified against Exophase and PSNProfiles, 2026-11-19). Guides are this entry's own words, drawn only from the official descriptions unless a source is named.

trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one unlocks by itself. It is the reward for the whole list, not a task of its own. Work through the roadmap in order and check the platinum last — there is nothing to do for it directly, and no shortcut around the other 54.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
